The '''1st Wing Guard''' was a [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] assigned to the [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Wing Guard]]&mdash;a highly disorganized and corrupt [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]] run by thieves and bureaucrats&mdash;during the [[Baron Administrator/Legends|administrative barony]] of [[Dominic Raynor]], before he lost the office to [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]].

==History==
The 1st Wing Guard was a cloud car squadron that served as an airborne security force for Cloud City on Bespin.<ref name="SWPM" /> Just prior to [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the squadron was steeped in the corruption fostered by the despotic Baron Administrator, Dominic Raynor, and only provided protection to those who could pay for it.<ref name="SWPM" />

With the succession of Lando Calrissian as Baron Administrator through a Sabacc game, the corrupt pilots and officers were ousted and the squadron was reorganized<ref name="BWGITDB" /> into the [[2nd Wing Guard]] and led by the chief administrative aide, [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]]. 1st Wing Guard veterans that were not culled from the reorganization were reassigned to [[Wing Guard Elite]],<ref name="Veteran">{{PocketModel|set=Scum & Villainy|cardname=Elite Wing Guard cloud car|link=https://www.starwars-universe.com/collectionnables-serie-356-scum-R-villainy.html#carte}}</ref> a special airborne unit formed out of the 1st and 2nd Wing Guard squadrons.<ref name="Veteran" /><ref name="SWPM" />

==Description==
Based in [[Cloud City Security Tower]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]],<ref name="BWGITDB" /> the 1st Wing Guard's [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]] were painted [[Color/Legends|orange]] and offered minimal protection to the pilots who flew them.<ref name="SWPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 1st Wing Guard was represented by a miniature in the ''[[Scum & Villainy]]'' expansion of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]''.<ref name="SWPM" />
